slides.title: Your knee, explained
slides.body: What we found and what happens next.
slides.notes: Sit beside them, not across. Keep the phone between you.

slides.title: A small tear in the meniscus.
slides.body: Common, and it usually heals without surgery.
slides.notes: Say 'common' early. It lowers the temperature.

slides.title: The plan
slides.body:
Six weeks of physio
Ice after activity
No running until week four
Check-in on the twelfth
slides.notes: Walk each line. Ask what their week looks like.

slides.title: You'll be fine.
slides.body: The plan is in your inbox.
